definitions.gloss: densely; lushly; thickly (of trees or vegetation)
definitions.explanation: Describes vegetation growing thickly enough to block out light and create a shadowy atmosphere. Almost always paired with verbs of growing or covering.

examples.japanese: ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧うっそうと⟦{茂|しげ}る→茂る：03924_shigeru⟧。
うっそうと⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: I walked through a thickly wooded forest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、うっそうと⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{杉|すぎ}→杉：03889_sugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{何百年|なんびゃくねん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{立|た}ち→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Around the old shrine, dense cedars had stood for hundreds of years.

notes:
Sometimes written {鬱蒼|うっそう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ in formal text but more commonly in kana. Often carries a slightly gloomy or atmospheric nuance — the density blocks light.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- うっそうと⟦{茂|しげ}る→茂る：03924_shigeru⟧: grow densely
- うっそうと⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧: thickly wooded forest
- うっそうと⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{木立|こだち}→木立：19883_kodachi⟧: dense grove
- うっそうと⟦{生|お}い{茂|しげ}る→生い茂る：22515_oishigeru⟧: grow thickly and lushly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{青々|あおあお}→青々：19447_aoao⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: vivid green — emphasizes color, not density
- ⟦もこもこ→もこもこ：05361_mokomoko⟧: bushy; fluffy — visual texture, not specifically vegetation
- {鬱蒼|うっそう}たる: same meaning, more literary/formal form
